featured_reviews.name: Ankan Singhal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited August Café recently and came away with mixed feelings.

We ordered the Mushroom Sandwich on sourdough, Paneer Tikka Panini, Pink Sauce Pasta, Veg Burger with fries, Cold Chocolate, and ended the meal with a Chocolate Cake.

Starting with the sandwiches, the Mushroom Sandwich was unfortunately quite dry and lacked the moisture and flavour you would expect. The Paneer Tikka Panini had the opposite problem, the mustard was so overpowering that it completely dominated the dish, making it taste more like a mustard sandwich than a paneer tikka panini.

The Pink Sauce Pasta was decent but nothing memorable. It wasn't bad, but it didn't stand out either.

The Veg Burger was actually the star of the meal. It was well-made, flavourful, and easily the best savoury dish we ordered. However, what left a sour taste was being charged ₹50 extra to make just a handful of fries peri-peri. Charging that amount for a full portion is understandable, but for barely six fries on the side, it felt excessive and unnecessary.

The Cold Chocolate was another disappointment—not because of the taste, which was perfectly fine, but because of the quantity. The portion felt quite small for the price being charged.

Thankfully, dessert ended the meal on a positive note. The Chocolate Cake was rich, delicious, and probably the highlight of the entire experience.

Overall, August Café has a pleasant atmosphere and some good offerings, but the food lacked consistency and some of the pricing decisions felt difficult to justify. Not a bad experience, but not one that left a strong impression either.

⭐⭐⭐ (3/5)

featured_reviews.name: Adriel Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited August Café recently and had quite a mixed but overall pleasant experience.

Starting with the Pho, this unfortunately missed the mark. It wasn’t authentic, used the wrong type of noodles, and the balance of flavours was overwhelmed by an excess of chilli oil and flakes. The Soy Chilli Noodles were also underwhelming; they lacked depth and flavour, and didn’t really stand out as a noodle dish.

On the brighter side, the Nachos were, as always, spot on, crisp, generously topped, and satisfying. The Chicken Steak with Peri Peri Sauce was another highlight, perfectly cooked, tender, and flavourful, paired beautifully with fresh, well-seasoned vegetables.

For drinks, the Elderberry Fizz with soda and basil seeds was refreshing and unique, while the Cappuccino was smooth and well-prepared.

Desserts were a strong finish to the meal; there’s a great variety to choose from. The Tiramisu Waffle was indulgent without being overly sweet, and the Ice Cream Sundae with a brownie base, ice cream, and caramel sauce was rich and satisfying.

The service deserves special mention, the staff are exceptionally polite, attentive, and quick. There’s an air-conditioned indoor section for comfort, as well as outdoor seating with a smoking area for those who prefer al fresco dining.

Not every dish hit the right note, but the warm service and pleasant ambience stood out. That said, for the meal we had and the overall experience, the pricing felt steep. While the service and setting are commendable, some dishes need refinement for the cost to feel justified.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Stopped by Sequel in Bandra looking for a break from the intense spices I've been having on my trip to Mumbai, and it definitely delivered on that front. The ambiance is 10/10—super clean, very aesthetic, and a great place to hang out. The service was also top-notch; the staff is really attentive. Unfortunately when I visited, the wifi wasn't working, so I wasn't able to work there like I planned.

I ordered the Fold Over Omelette and the Super Green Smoothie. Both hit the spot for a lighter, "clean" meal. My only critique is that I wish the flavors were a bit more developed! Compared to healthy food spots I’ve frequented in the States, the taste felt a little flat. I also would love to see some higher-protein additions with chicken on the menu.

Overall, a solid choice if you want something healthy and light in a beautiful setting!

featured_reviews.name: Pete Wilkes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sequel in Bandra is my absolute go-to for a healthy breakfast or lunch. When I want food that actually makes me feel good afterwards, this is where I head.

The ingredients are consistently clean, organic, and clearly well sourced… you can taste the care that goes into every dish. It’s the kind of place where you don’t have to second-guess what you’re eating, which matters to me as a aromatherapist and nutritionist.

The menu always feels nourishing rather than restrictive, and I love that I can eat here regularly and still feel light and energised.

On top of that, the service is always great. Genuinely welcoming without being in your face. It’s one of those places that gets both food and experience right, every single time.

If you’re looking for real, honest, feel-good food in Bandra, Sequel is a standout.
.

I recently tried the Falafel Pita Pocket, Greek Feta Pita Pocket, and the Broccoli Corn Pesto Sandwich— and each item was a delightful surprise.

The Pita Pockets were impressive - generously filled with fresh greens, olives, cucumbers, and crumbly feta. The flavors were vibrant, authentic  & perfectly spiced.

But the real standout was the Broccoli Corn Pesto Sandwich. It’s not something I expected to love as much as I did. The pesto was aromatic and rich, while the broccoli and corn added a nice texture and sweetness. It was hearty, fresh, and incredibly moreish.

The packaging was clean, eco-friendly, and kept everything intact without any mess.

Highly recommend Salad Days for anyone who values taste, quality, and freshness in every bite.

Please keep up the good work. Will definitely be ordering again soon!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Instagrammable Bandra café with average food and high prices 📸

Visited Juco Café around 2 PM for lunch. The café is quite small and a bit cramped with just about four tables, but I have to say — the ambience is super aesthetic, vibrant, and cozy. It’s one of those cute little spots that photograph really well and give off good vibes.

We ordered a few things to try:
🍜 Japanese Ramen Bowl (₹520) – The quantity was generous, and the flavours were quite nice. It’s a comforting bowl and filling enough for one person.
🍳 Shakshouka (₹400) – This one was surprisingly good! The taste was on point, and the portion size was enough for two people to share.
🥤 Blueberry Spirulina Smoothie (₹400) – Sadly, this was the only miss for us. It mostly tasted like banana with barely any blueberry flavour, so it didn’t feel worth the price.

The service was quite slow — it took about 35–40 minutes for our food to arrive, even though the café wasn’t crowded when we visited.

Overall, I’d give 3/5 stars. The pricing is definitely on the higher side, and while the food was decent, it’s not something I’d crave to go back for (except maybe to try their smoothie bowls next time!).

Bombay Salad Co., Bandra – Healthy, Hearty & Actually Delicious 🥗☕

Sip • Grab • Taste

Visited Bombay Salad Co. on a Saturday with family, and this place genuinely delivers on the healthy-but-still-tasty promise. The menu is built for health-conscious eaters, but even someone who isn’t into salads will find plenty to enjoy here.

📍 Location & Access
It’s located just off Linking Road, but the approach lane is quite narrow. Valet parking is not available, so if you’re driving, it’s smarter to park a little ahead and walk. Avoid taking the car right to the door not worth the stress.

🍴 What We Ordered:

Three Salad Bowls – we chose the small bowls, but the portions were still surprisingly generous. Fresh greens, good balance of protein and crunch, and well-made dressings nothing watery or bland here.

Cappuccino – smooth, well-made, not bitter. A nice warm pairing with fresh salads.

✨ Ambience & Experience
The vibe is calm, cozy, and “feel good” without trying too hard. Staff is polite, service is steady, and the ingredients felt fresh  which is the real win for a salad-focused place.

⭐ Overall Verdict:
If you're looking for healthy food that doesn't taste like a compromise, Bombay Salad Co. hits the mark.
Great for a relaxed meal, post-gym brunch, or a weekend family catch-up.

Office people favorite place
The famous veg quick bite outlet which is located in Goregaon East near to Ram mandir station and exactly back gate of Nirlon Knowledge Park where all office going people like to visit this outlet for breakfast, brunch, lunch and quick bites in evening. You'll enjoy here all types of dosas, sandwiches, misal pav and paav bhaji.
